title: Eisenstein: AI as gift economy or market logic
summary: The same matching technology can enable a gift economy at scale (matching needs with gifts, tracking reciprocity) or amplify market logic (monetising everything and destroying the remaining gift relationships). The resolution is to coordinate markets with the gift economy, not replace one with the other.
source: Ch09 §9.2 — Charles Eisenstein, gift economy (replaces the Menegon mutual-aid figure)
